info.name: Alamelmarateb ERP — v1
info.description: Alamelmarateb ERP v1 — Catalog, Inventory, Sales, CRM, Identity. Login first, paste tokens into variables. Swagger UI: {{baseUrl}}/swagger-ui.html | Contract: ApiResponse{success,message,data,errors} (X-Trace-Id header only); every /api call needs X-Api-Client + X-Api-Key headers (clientId/clientKey vars); X-Lang ar|en; Idempotency-Key on place-order/complete-sale; X-Trace-Id echoed; 400 syntax vs 422 semantics vs 409 conflict; 404 unknown route; 405 wrong method + Allow; 429 + Retry-After. | Tokens auto-save: login/register/refresh store access+refresh into adminJwt/managerJwt/customerJwt/keeperJwt/cashierJwt (+*Refresh, refreshToken, userId) based on the account role. Just log in and call the rest.
